dynamic_line.yes: If you get me a sample, I'll join your crazy camp expedition.  Hell, if you bring me a sample maybe I'll help you set up a lab to study this stuff.  Almost anything could work, but if this stuff is as dangerous as you make it sound, maybe make sure it's not a sporulating body.
dynamic_line.no: I dunno, scientific interest?  If you don't bring me anything, no worries.  I'm positively swimming in entertainment here, as you can see.

responses.text: It just so happens I have a chunk of fungal matter on me right now.
It just so happens I have a chunk of fungal matter on me right now.
Sure, I'd better get going.  I'll see if I can find you something.

dynamic_line:
Well.  Well, well, well.  This is really interesting.  Look, you can see reticulations here, it looks sort of like an enlarged piece of a stipe from a basidiocarp… but look at this, these fibers are clearly unlike anything I've seen before.  I wonder if they're motile?

Okay, listen: you've got yourself a deal.  I'll come to your base, but you've gotta get me hooked up with a microscope as soon as you can.  This could be the beginning of something really cool.  Oh, and it should go without saying that I'm not coming unless you can find a place for my friends here in your base.  I'm sure you anticipated that.  Talk them into going and I'm in.  It should be easy, they're a bunch of sweet hearted saps.

responses.text: Great!  I'll go see what I can do about that.
